explanation: f(n) = maxMOLS n is the largest size of a pairwise-orthogonal set of Latin squares of order n, with orthogonality meaning (i,j) ↦ (L_ij, M_ij) is injective, as on erdosproblems.com/724. Question: is f(n) ≫ n^{1/2}? The statement asks for c > 0 with c√n ≤ f(n) for all large n. Faithful.
